My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?

I'm sorry to hear that one of your items arrived damaged. Here's what you should do:
Document the Damage:
Take clear photos of the damaged packaging (especially if it shows signs of shipping damage)
Take photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
Include a common object near the damage to show scale
If the item has a law tag with a barcode, photograph both the front and back
Contact Our Support Team:
Email the photos and a description of the damage to support@avocadomattress.com
Include your order details, email, and current shipping address for faster processing
The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps
What to Expect:
You should receive a confirmation email within 12-72 hours after reporting the damage
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days (not including any production time needed to make the replacement item)
